decision_conditions: <p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: Flo<span style="font-size: 12pt;">od&nbsp;Risk&nbsp;Assessment;&nbsp;VC.07.EX.01;&nbsp;VC.07.EX.02;&nbsp;VC.07.EX.03;&nbsp;VC.07.EX.PR.2SP Rev A: VC.PR.FCL.201;&nbsp;VC.PR.FCL.202; Reasonable Exception Statement; Location Plan;&nbsp;VC.07.PR.201;&nbsp;VC.07.PR.202;&nbsp;VC.07.PR.203;&nbsp;VC.07.PR.204; Planning Statement.</span></p><p></p>
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

<p><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">The development hereby permitted shall be used for Class C3 dwellinghouse(s) only and notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any Order revoking or re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no development within Schedule 2, Part 3, Class L shall take place.</span></span></p><p><br></p><p><br></p>
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;"><u>Landscaping Implementation</u></span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">All planting, seeding or turfing comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried out in the first planting and seeding seasons following the occupation of the building(s), or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner. Any existing or new trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development, die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced in the next planting season, with others of a similar size and species, unless the local authority agrees any variation in writing.</span></span></p><p><br data-cke-eol="1"></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;"><strong><u>Sewage&nbsp;Disposal</u></strong></span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">The development hereby permitted shall not be commenced until works for the disposal of sewage have been provided on site in accordance with details to be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The works shall thereafter be retained.</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">To ensure that the necessary construction and design criteria for the development proposals follow approved conditions.</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">The applicant should contact Thames Water Utilities Limited and the Harrow Infrastructure Team at the earliest opportunity.</span></span></p><p><br></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;"><u>Refuse Storage</u></span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">The refuse bins shall be stored at all times, other than on collection days, in the designated refuse storage area, as shown on the approved drawing.</span></span></p><p><br></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;"><u>Landscaping</u></span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">Notwithstanding the approved details, the development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until there has been a scheme of hard and soft landscape works for the site submitted to, and approved by, the local planning authority. Soft landscape works shall include: planting plans, including details for soft landscaping of the property frontage with provision for a maximum of one on-site car parking space, and schedules of plants, noting <a>species</a>, plant sizes and proposed numbers / densities. Hard landscape works shall include; details of boundary treatments (materials, scale of boundary, location) to demarcate access to, and the boundaries between, the subdivided rear garden, details (siting, materials, size, type of storage unit) of bin storage facilities to be provided, <a>allocation of one&nbsp;car parking space (2.4m x 4.8m) on the front forecourt, </a><a>details of hard surfacing materials&nbsp;</a>to be used in the landscaping of the site.</span></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;"><u>Boundary Fencing</u></span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">The outdoor rear private garden areas shown on the approved plans shall be bounded by close-boarded timber fencing to a maximum height of 1.8 metres (from natural ground level) prior to the first occupation of the flats hereby approved and shall be retained thereafter in accordance with the approved details</span></span></p><p><br></p><p><br></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;"><strong><u>Surface Water&nbsp;Disposal</u></strong></span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">The development of any buildings hereby permitted shall not be commenced until works for the disposal of surface water have been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority.</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">To ensure that the necessary construction and design criteria for the development proposals follow approved conditions according to NPPF.</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">The applicant should contact Harrow Drainage Section at the earliest opportunity.</span></span></p><p><br></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">Prior to occupation of the development, a Fire Safety Statement shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, this statement shall include details of how the development will function in terms of the following:</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">1) identify suitably positioned unobstructed outside space: a) for fire appliances to be positioned on b) appropriate for use as an evacuation assembly point</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">2) is designed to incorporate appropriate features which reduce the risk to life and the risk of serious injury in the event of a fire; including appropriate fire alarm systems and passive and active fire safety measures</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">3) is constructed in an appropriate way to minimise the risk of fire spread</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">4) provide suitable and convenient means of escape, and associated evacuation strategy for all building users</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">5) develop a robust management strategy for evacuation which is to be periodically updated and published (details of how often this management strategy is to be reviewed and published to be included), and which all building users can have confidence in</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">6) provide suitable access and equipment for firefighting which is appropriate for the size and use of the development.</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">The development shall be operated in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.</span></span></p><p><br></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;"><u>Cycle Parking</u></span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">The approved secure cycle parking as shown on the approved drawing shall be installed prior to the first occupation of the flats hereby approved and shall thereafter be retained in accordance with the approved details.</span></span></p>
description: Conversion of dwelling to 2 x 3 bed flats;  conversion of garage to habitable room with  installation of window to front; single storey rear extension; alterations and extension to roof to form end gable; rear dormer; two rooflights in front roof slope; alterations to the front elevation at ground floor level; external alterations; separate amenity space; boundary treatment;  bin / cycle storage (demolition of rear extension)
